content: भोगिन् {%a.%} [भोग-इनि] .²1 Eating. .²2 Enjoying. .²3 Suffering, experiencing, enduring. .²4 Using, possessing (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in these four senses.) .²5 Having curves, having large body; अभवन् पन्नगास्त्रस्ता भोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः <ls>Rām. 6. 50. 35</ls> (<ab>com.</ab>). .²6 Having hoods. .²7 Devoted to enjoyment, indulging in sensual pleasures; भोगिनः कञ्चुकाविष्टाः कुटिलाः क्रूरचेष्टिताः . सुदुष्टा मन्त्रसाध्याश्च राजानः पन्नगा इव .. <ls>Pt. 1. 65</ls> (where it has sense 6 also). .²8 Rich, opulent. --{%m.%} .²1 A snake; गजाजिनालम्बि पिनद्धभोगि वा <ls>Ku. 5. 78</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 32</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 48</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 59</ls>. .²2 A king. .²3 A voluptuary. .²4 A barber. .²5 The headman of a village. .²6 The lunar mansion आश्लेषा. .{@-नी@} .²1 A woman belonging to the kingʼs harem, but not consecrated with him, the concubine of a king. .²2 A kind of heroine.
